_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY, NOT APPROVED. stage docker_kvm_small: stock OSWorld Docker/KVM cold-reset baseline on one m7i.xlarge (4 vCPU, 16 GiB, $0.2016/h Linux us-east-1 as given by the owner). ceiling_hours plus stop_margin_hours must stay within 2 hours provision-to-terminate. ebs_gb must come from deploy/aws_host/size_image.py (docs/aws-small-stage-plan.md section 3), not a guess.
image_id: OWNER: resolved Ubuntu 24.04 amd64 AMI id in us-east-1
cpu_options: OWNER: copy any nested-virtualization launch option from the live describe-instance-types result, or delete this field if none is needed
ami_owner_id: OWNER: 12-digit account id that owns the AMI (stated by the owner, checked against describe-images)
